title: Product Feature Callout Videos | AIVideosUGC
description: Show one product detail in a focused callout video from a single photo. Choose 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds for feeds, listings and product pages.
h1: Product Feature Callout Video for One Clear Detail
lead: Show one part up close, such as a pump or a lid. Add a voice and captions if you want, then post a clip shoppers can follow.
steps_h2: How to Make a Product Feature Callout Video in 3 Simple Steps
steps_lead: One moving part, then a script, a voice, and captions if you want them.

steps.d: Upload one sharp photo of the whole item, or paste a product page link. Keep the moving part visible.
Name the one action. Add a script, a voice, and captions if you want them, then pick a size and length.
Download the file, check it against the real item, and publish to TikTok, Instagram, or Facebook.

faq.q: What is a product feature callout video?
faq.a: A short clip about one moving part, such as a pump, a lid, a hinge, or a clasp. An AI actor can demonstrate it, with a script, a voice, and captions. You can still edit the words.

faq.q: How do I make a product feature callout video?
faq.a: Upload a photo or paste a product page link, describe that one action, pick a voice and a length, then download. Lengths are 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds.

faq.q: Why use this instead of filming a creator?
faq.a: You can make another version without booking a shoot or waiting on a creator's calendar. Review the file against the real product before you post.

faq.q: Which shops use a product feature callout video?
faq.a: Beauty, electronics, home, and other shops that need a listing or a paid ad to show how one part works.
Yes. Pick a scene, upload a clear photo, and follow the three steps. You do not need an editing background to get a first file.

faq.q: Which industries does this template fit?
faq.a: Ecommerce shops in beauty, home, food, fitness, and other consumer goods. You can make a new clip from the same photo when the audience changes.

faq.q: Can I upload my own photo or start from a link?
faq.a: Yes. Upload your product photo, or paste a public product page link so the clip starts from that page's main image and product name.
Publish to TikTok, Instagram, or Facebook from here, or download and post it yourself. You can pick tall 9:16, square 1:1, or wide 16:9. 4:3 and 3:4 are there too.

faq.q: Do I need a paid plan?
faq.a: Yes. Starter is $24.50 a month with 200 credits, Pro is $35 with 300, and Premium is $63 with 600. You see each job's credit cost first. A failed job returns its credits.

faq.q: Can I use the video in ads?
faq.a: Yes. Downloads have no watermark, and you can use them in your own ads, pages, and posts. Anyone on camera is an AI actor, not a customer.
A scene gives you a setup for one feature so you are not inventing the shot from nothing. You still check the motion against the real item.

more_sections.h2: Features for a Feature Callout Video
more_sections.lead: Use these while you build the clip around one moving part.

items.d: Pick a voice for the spoken line, or copy a voice you are allowed to use. The line can say the product name while the picture shows it.
Captions can sit with the spoken line so the point is readable while the clip plays. You can edit the wording before you publish.
Describe the shot in a sentence. A draft turns that into the line an actor says, and you can rewrite it before the video is made.
Browse [AI actors](page:ai-actors) and pick someone to hold or point at the product. You can use that same person in the next clip.
Trim in the built-in editor, add a track from the music library, and make the same clip again in another language.

Make several versions from one photo, publish to TikTok, Instagram, or Facebook from here, or start the job from your own software (API). Each job spends [credits](page:pricing) (points on your plan).

reviews.h2: How Shops Show One Moving Part
reviews.lead: Each card is how one type of shop shows a single moving part. These are examples, not customer quotes.

items.d: A beauty shop presses the cleanser pump once, so that one action is the whole clip.
A drinkware shop opens a travel-mug lid so the seal is the feature on screen.
A home shop opens a hinged storage lid once so the hinge stays on screen.
A home shop turns a clasp on a ceramic container toward the camera.
An electronics shop holds one port to the camera so a listing can show where the cable goes.
A bag shop runs a zipper once along the track so the hardware is the point of the clip.
An apparel shop shortens a strap once so the strap adjuster is easy to see.
A kitchen shop locks a lid shut in one motion, so the product page can replay that move.
A beauty shop turns a cap off so the closure, not the whole routine, is the subject.
A tool shop presses one button so the control is easy to see, with no second feature on screen.

definition.title: What Is a Product Feature Callout Video?
paras: A product feature callout video is a short clip built around one moving part, such as a pump, a lid, a hinge, or a clasp. An AI actor can demonstrate it, with a script, a voice, and captions.
Start from your product photo or a public product page link. Pick a tall, square, or wide shape and a length, then download a file you can post on a listing or in a paid ad.

reasons.h2: Reasons to Use a Feature Callout Video
reasons.lead: For a shop that needs one function to be obvious on a phone.

items.d: A single pump, zipper, or clasp is easier to follow than a pile of benefits squeezed into one clip.

items.t: Your Photo or a Product Link
items.d: The item on screen starts from the photo you upload, or from the main image on a [product page link](page:url-to-video).

items.t: An Actor Can Point to It
items.d: Choose an AI actor to hold the product and draw attention to the part that matters.
A draft script, a spoken line, and on-screen captions can come with the clip. You can still edit the line.
Change the actor, the language, or the opening and make a second clip without booking a shoot.
